SELECT DISTINCT s.clause AS clause, d.number AS document,
       ds.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM document AS a
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS acs ON acs.cr = a.id
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = acs.section_id
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS cs ON cs.section_id = s.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = cs.cr
JOIN disposition AS ds ON ds.target = d.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
JOIN cr_in_pack AS cp ON cp.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
WHERE a.number = 'R2-2102518'
  AND a.cr_number = '0523'
  AND a.spec = '38.306'
  AND a.target_release = 'Rel-16'
  AND s.spec = a.spec
  AND s.release = 'Rel-16'

  AND d.spec = s.spec
  AND d.target_release = s.release
  AND ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND ds.scope = 'whole_target'
  AND m.wg = 'RAN2'

         p.tsg_number AS tsg_number

  JOIN cr_modifies_section AS cs ON cs.cr = d.id
  JOIN section AS s ON s.id = cs.section_id
  JOIN cr_in_pack AS cp ON cp.cr = d.id
  JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
  WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
    AND s.spec = d.spec
    AND s.release = d.target_release
),
verified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.target AS document_id
  FROM disposition AS ds
  JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
  WHERE ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
    AND ds.scope = 'whole_target'

         s.spec AS specification, s.release AS release, s.clause AS clause,
         p.pack_number AS cr_pack, p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting,
         p.tsg_number AS tsg_number
  FROM document AS d
  JOIN cr_modifies_section AS cs ON cs.cr = d.id
  JOIN section AS s ON s.id = cs.section_id
  JOIN cr_in_pack AS cp ON cp.cr = d.id
  JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = cp.pack_id
  WHERE d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
    AND s.spec = d.spec
    AND s.release = d.target_release
),
verified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.target AS document_id
  FROM disposition AS ds
  JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
  WHERE ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
    AND ds.scope = 'whole_target'
    AND m.wg = 'RAN2'
),
current_changes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.*
  FROM changes AS c
  JOIN verified AS v ON v.document_id = c.document_id
  WHERE c.cr_pack = 'RP-201163'
    AND c.release IN ('Rel-15', 'Rel-16')
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.document AS document, c.specification AS specification,
       c.clause AS clause
FROM current_changes AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM changes AS earlier
  WHERE earlier.section_id = c.section_id
    AND earlier.tsg_number < c.tsg_number
)

       ds.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM document AS a

  AND a.target_release = 'Rel-17'
  AND s.spec = a.spec
  AND s.release = 'Rel-17'
  AND d.id <> a.id
  AND d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'
  AND d.spec = s.spec
  AND d.target_release = s.release
  AND ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND ds.scope = 'whole_target'
  AND m.wg = 'RAN2'
